name: DNP DS-RX1 · 6×4 PC · 2-inch cut · borderless
description: Two 2×6 strips printed side by side on one 6×4 sheet and cut apart by the printer's 2-inch cut, borderless. From the Phase 6C observations on the Windows research laptop and the owner's test print on the same printer (2026-11-19).

driverVersion.note: Driver installed on the research laptop; the production booth PC's driver is not yet recorded.

driverPageMm.note: Page size of the one borderless page dslrBooth sent for the _2x sheet; larger than the paper, so the excess is expected to be lost at the edges.

borderless.note: dslrBooth sent the _2x sheet as one borderless page; the saved print settings had the print margin off.

cuts.label: 2-inch centre cut
cuts.note: CUT_2INCH in the printer settings dslrBooth saved: a printer-driver setting, not a template or dslrBooth option. Where the cut falls on the paper is not yet measured.

top.note: Estimated from the driver page size against the paper; not measured. The owner's test print (2026-11-19) showed no visible trim problem.

bottom.note: Estimated from the driver page size against the paper; not measured. The owner's test print (2026-11-19) showed no visible trim problem.

left.note: Outer long edge. Estimated from the driver page size against the paper; not measured. The owner's test print (2026-11-19) showed no visible trim problem.

right.note: Outer long edge. Estimated from the driver page size against the paper; not measured. The owner's test print (2026-11-19) showed no visible trim problem.

cut.note: Loss at the cut is not measured. The owner's test print (2026-11-19) showed no visible cut or spacing discrepancy.

edge.note: Keep critical content at least 3 mm from the strip edges. Kept as a conservative margin after the owner's test print (2026-11-19) showed no visible problem; trim is not measured exactly.

cut.note: Keep critical content at least 3 mm from the centre cut. Kept as a conservative margin after the owner's test print (2026-11-19) showed no visible problem; trim is not measured exactly.

autoCut.value: Yes: the printer cut each sheet into two strips
autoCut.note: Owner's test print on the research printer (2026-11-19), visual check.

cutOnSeam.value: Yes: no visible cut or spacing discrepancy; both strips match
cutOnSeam.note: Owner's test print on the research printer (2026-11-19), visual check; not measured.

gutter.value: None visible: no white gap at the cut
gutter.note: Owner's test print on the research printer (2026-11-19), visual check.

setup: In dslrBooth, use the native 2×6 template from Template Studio's export ("Print 2 per page" on).
In the DNP DS-RX1 printer settings, choose the 2-inch cut and turn the print margin off (borderless).
Keep critical content at least 3 mm from the strip edges and the centre cut.
observedEnvironment: Windows 11 research laptop with dslrBooth 7.48 and the DNP DS-RX1 (Phase 6C Stage 1 and the owner's test print); not the production booth PC.
notes: Template Studio shows this sheet upright: 4 in wide × 6 in tall with the two strips side by side. The driver page is the same sheet in landscape (156.1 × 105.0 mm).

Approved by the owner for production use (2026-11-19) after a test print looked right: both strips matched, the cut was clean and there was no white gap. Trim distances are estimates, not measurements; it has not been verified on the production booth PC.
The printer's cut and margins are configured in the printer driver, never in the template.
